text:
jess: Quick sync — Veridian SI asked which security artifacts we expect for the upcoming joint marketplace listing. They specifically called out SOC2, pen test report, vulnerability scan exports, and the partner questionnaire. They want to know: (1) which items we will presign for them, (2) what we expect them to upload, and (3) redaction guidance. Can we map owners and an upload flow?
omar: Thanks Jess. Short answer: we presign only a small set (attestations + non-sensitive configs). Partners upload reports (pen + scans) to a presigned bucket we create. But we need clarity from Sec on redaction + what counts as "attestation" vs "sensitive artifact". cc @lucy
lucy: Hi — correct summary. Our current playbook: SOC2 summary + AICPA letter = presign (we keep full report behind an NDA channel). Full pen report should be uploaded by partner and redacted for PII/creds. We require a redaction checklist before we accept. See: https://redwood.example.com/internal/marketplace-evidence-guidelines (private).
mark: From infra side, we can create a time-bound presign with the following pattern:
```
aws s3 presign put-object --bucket rw-marketplace-ingest --key veridian/partner-archive.tgz --expires-in 3600
```
We'll tag uploads with `marketplace:veridian` and `env:partners`. Automated scan triggers will run after upload.
sec-bot: Required artifacts for partner listing (per checklist v2.1):
- SOC2: attestation summary (presign) + full report (partner-uploaded, redacted)
- External pen test: partner-uploaded (redacted), plus pen-scope doc (presign)
- Auth config: screenshots of SSO/OIDC (presign)
- Vulnerability scans: partner-uploaded raw exports (CSV/JSON)
- Completed partner questionnaire: presign (we store a copy)
lucy: Redaction checklist highlights: remove IP addresses that map to internal-only ranges, redact any org-specific credential tokens, redact third-party customer data. Keep a mapping file for redactions so Sec can validate (we do NOT accept "redacted by screenshot" as sufficient). Also: if the partner's pen report contains exploit POCs, those must be redacted unless we sign an additional NDA.
ojmar: small correction — timeline we promised: partner upload window = 7 days after presign token issued. We should confirm they can complete redaction within that.
mark: infra note — presigned objects expire in 1h by default but we'll generate a manifest with 7-day window where they can retry via a refresh endpoint. We'll log every presign generation and attach owner tags.
jess: Owners proposal: Partnerships (omar) = coordinate presign issuance + partner comms; Eng-Infra (mark) = create buckets, tags, logs; Security (lucy) = redaction checklist + final acceptance; Legal (not in thread) = NDA + retention policy. Does that map look ok?
lucy: yes. Add: Security will require a single reviewer and a backup reviewer for any uploads older than 24h. Also we need contact for the partner engineer who can attest to remediation timelines.
omar: I'll draft the email to Veridian with a short checklist and the presign link template. Draft ETA EOD today. jess, can you confirm Partnerships will own follow-ups?
jess: Yep, I'll own follow-ups and make sure Legal is looped for the NDA clause.
mark: One last technical ask: can Sec confirm acceptable scan formats (Nessus, Qualys, JSON from Trivy, etc.)? We should list them in the presign instructions to reduce churn.
lucy: Acceptable formats = Nessus (.nessus/.xml), Qualys exports (.csv), Trivy/Clair JSON. If partner sends proprietary scanner format, require a converted export. I'll add that to the checklist doc.
sec-bot: Action items:
- Omar: draft mail + attach checklist (due today)
- Mark: create presign bucket + manifest endpoint (due tomorrow)
- Lucy: finalize redaction checklist + accepted scan formats (due today)
- Jess: loop Legal and own follow-ups (ongoing)
jess: Thanks all — Omar post the draft here when ready and I'll tweak language for the partner-facing tone. :thumbsup:
omar: Draft incoming in 30m.
